verdict.rationale: Docs show each workspace has its own diff and review path, and Conductor explicitly helps you 'review the diff, open a pull request, merge' before finishing work, plus it surfaces PR comments and failing-check logs even while a cloud workspace sleeps, and agents can run builds/tests as part of setup. However, there's no detailed description of built-in linting/test-runner integration beyond agent-run builds, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that this catches real problems pre-merge. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/check-running feature docs, independent verification of diff/check accuracy, and coverage of how failing checks block or warn before merge.
